miniatures/animated-chains.title: Animated Chains
miniatures/animated-chains.description: Six lengths of chain reared up off their bases like snakes, each one twisted from wire and rusted with washes. The spell lasts one minute. The paint took rather longer.

miniatures/armored-jeep.title: Armored Jeep
miniatures/armored-jeep.description: A jeep plated in scrap with a corrugated ram on the front and a twin-barrelled turret bolted to the bed, rusted and chipped down to bare metal. The hand-painted smiley on the ram plate clears up any confusion about whose side it is on.

miniatures/artificer.title: Artificer
miniatures/artificer.description: An artificer perched beneath her own oversized turret, strung with red tubing and standing in a nest of tiny tools. Every one of those gadgets is a separate speck of paint.

miniatures/ballista.title: Ballista
miniatures/ballista.description: A siege ballista on a drybrushed timber frame, with a skull bolted to the shield in case the giant crossbow was too subtle.

miniatures/big-kraken.title: Big Kraken
miniatures/big-kraken.description: Tentacles sprawling far past the base, painted in a pink-to-violet gradient that deepens toward the mantle, with dark red bled into every hooked claw.

miniatures/blimpy.title: Blimpy
miniatures/blimpy.description: A bartender as much as a barbarian, raising a tray of beer and bread over a mound of splintered weapons, orange mohawk and braided beard streaming behind him. His serving hand is kitbashed from the original model so he is carrying drinks instead of swinging steel, which was a fun challenge.

miniatures/bloody-vampire.title: Bloody Vampire
miniatures/bloody-vampire.description: A vampire mid-gloat with bat wings spread and a sword in hand, standing over a dismembered body on bloodied cobblestones. That base took more red than was strictly necessary.

miniatures/blue-cloaker.title: Blue Cloaker
miniatures/blue-cloaker.description: A cloaker drifting on a clear flight stand, deep blue with a row of amber eyes down its edge and long pale fangs curving out of the dark. You notice the teeth slightly too late.

miniatures/blue-dragonborn-paladin.title: Blue Dragonborn Paladin
miniatures/blue-dragonborn-paladin.description: A blue-scaled dragonborn paladin in gold armour, red cloak streaming behind and a translucent flame blade raised overhead. The cloak and the flame carry the same sweep of motion.

miniatures/brain-collector.title: Brain Collector
miniatures/brain-collector.description: A dome of pale brain sacs carried on a crab-like body in teal and acid green, studded with pink eyes and grasping claws. Nothing about it is reassuring.

miniatures/brutal-gnoll.title: Brutal Gnoll
miniatures/brutal-gnoll.description: A gnoll mid-swing with a bloodied axe and a small round shield, standing on cobblestones. The gold armour plates catch the light against all that matted fur.

miniatures/bush-sneaky-man.title: Bush Sneaky Man
miniatures/bush-sneaky-man.description: A halfling scout hiding behind a shrub roughly four times his size. The stealth plan is not sophisticated, but it is committed.

miniatures/cassan.title: Cassan
miniatures/cassan.description: A tabaxi hauling an enormous crate across planking, tail out for balance. Grey fur over a warm wooden base, kept deliberately simple.

miniatures/clockwork-dragon.title: Clockwork Dragon
miniatures/clockwork-dragon.description: A brass clockwork dragon with exposed gearwork and patchwork stained-glass wings. The wing panels are painted individually, which is why it took as long as it did.

miniatures/cloud-of-daggers.title: Cloud Of Daggers
miniatures/cloud-of-daggers.description: A spell effect made physical: a fan of blades suspended over a single base, hovering in formation and waiting for someone to walk through.

miniatures/corgi-armored.title: Corgi Armored
miniatures/corgi-armored.description: A corgi in full plate barding on a cobblestone base, with a tiny blade clamped in its mouth. Stubby legs, complete confidence.

miniatures/dark-raven.title: Dark Raven
miniatures/dark-raven.description: A raven with wings spread on a bare branch, kept almost entirely black. The only paint doing real work here is the sheen.

miniatures/death-tyrant.title: Death Tyrant
miniatures/death-tyrant.description: A beholder reduced to a bone skull, its eyestalks regrown as pink nerve tipped with glowing amber, around a single violet central eye. Death did not noticeably improve its attitude.

miniatures/devil-lady.title: Devil Lady
miniatures/devil-lady.description: A horned devil with both wings thrown wide, red along every rib and fading to pale violet across the membranes. The armour is kept hot red to match.

miniatures/displacer-beast.title: Displacer Beast
miniatures/displacer-beast.description: A displacer beast in near-black blue, tentacles arched overhead and tipped with pale pads. Painted dark on purpose, so it reads exactly as well as it should.

miniatures/displacer-beast-mutilated.title: Displacer Beast Mutilated
miniatures/displacer-beast-mutilated.description: A displacer beast with its tentacles hacked off, one raw stump still dripping onto the cobblestones and the severed length lying where it fell. Whatever won this fight did not do so tidily.

miniatures/doppelganger-print.title: Doppelganger Print
miniatures/doppelganger-print.description: A doppelganger printed and painted in featureless blue, the face left completely blank. That blankness is the whole point of the creature.

miniatures/dragonborn-with-crows.title: Dragonborn With Crows
miniatures/dragonborn-with-crows.description: A dragonborn in silver armour with a blue sash, a serrated blade in hand and a column of steel-wool smoke rising behind with crows breaking out of it. The steel wool behaves about as well as you would expect.

miniatures/dungeon-doggy-monty.title: Dungeon Doggy Monty
miniatures/dungeon-doggy-monty.description: A beagle in a red harness with a blue bedroll strapped across his back and wraps on his legs, standing in static grass. Every good party needs a dog carrying the gear.

miniatures/dungeon-doggy-tobias.title: Dungeon Doggy Tobias
miniatures/dungeon-doggy-tobias.description: A corgi in pink barding with studded straps and packs, on a glowing magma base. Short legs, long inventory.

miniatures/early-orc-warrior.title: Early Orc Warrior
miniatures/early-orc-warrior.description: An orc mid-swing with a bloodied curved blade and a battered shield. Early work, and the mottled green skin shows where the technique was still being figured out.

miniatures/elf-archer.title: Elf Archer
miniatures/elf-archer.description: An elf drawing a bow at full extension, seen from behind and almost entirely swallowed by a hooded cloak, every fold highlighted down its length. She's braced on broken flagstones, but the cloak does all the storytelling.

miniatures/elf-sniper.title: Elf Sniper
miniatures/elf-sniper.description: An elf advancing with a long rifle levelled, in a green tunic with grey hair, crossing a patch of scrub and dried grass. The pose is all forward weight.

miniatures/eric-albright.title: Eric Albright
miniatures/eric-albright.description: A wizard in deep red robes with a pointed hat and a staff topped by an orb, planted on a grassy base. Exactly the sort of figure you would build for a favorite character.

miniatures/fairy-flies.title: Fairy Flies
miniatures/fairy-flies.description: A swarm of pale green fairies streaming off a mossy base in one long arc. Individually delicate, collectively a problem.

miniatures/familiar-fish.title: Familiar Fish
miniatures/familiar-fish.description: A small blue fish familiar with a red eye and a mouth full of yellow teeth, mounted over a sandy base scattered with coral. Tiny, toothy, and entirely out of its depth.

miniatures/fiery-martial-arts-robot.title: Fiery Martial Arts Robot
miniatures/fiery-martial-arts-robot.description: A robot mid-kata with fire breaking from both fists and feet, teased out of steel wool and blended orange into yellow. The body is painted in the same heat, so the whole figure reads as burning.

miniatures/fire-truck-war-wagon.title: Fire Truck War Wagon
miniatures/fire-truck-war-wagon.description: A six-wheeled war rig built out of a fire truck, complete with ram spikes and a bed full of cargo. Post-apocalyptic municipal services.

miniatures/first-orc.title: First Orc
miniatures/first-orc.description: The first orc, arms raised in triumph. Chunky, cheerful, and kept exactly as painted, because everyone should be able to see where they started.

miniatures/first-pixie.title: First Pixie
miniatures/first-pixie.description: An early pixie caught mid-giggle with both hands over her mouth, standing among pink flowers with her wings picked out in flat silver. Small, cheerful, and from very near the beginning.

miniatures/fox-samurai.title: Fox Samurai
miniatures/fox-samurai.description: A kitsune samurai in green and red, blade raised overhead on a gravel base. The tail is doing as much work in the silhouette as the sword.

miniatures/francis-the-corgi.title: Francis The Corgi
miniatures/francis-the-corgi.description: A corgi in a strapped-on jetpack rig with the exhaust blooming pink underneath, entirely unbothered by the payload. Named, and clearly beloved.

miniatures/frog-demon.title: Frog Demon
miniatures/frog-demon.description: A hunched amphibian demon on a rocky slab, glossy green with red claws and spines. The wet-looking skin is doing the heavy lifting.

miniatures/gargoyles.title: Gargoyles
miniatures/gargoyles.description: A rank of gargoyles lined up wing to wing, still unpainted. Six identical snarls, all waiting their turn.

miniatures/garren-bromson.title: Garren Bromson
miniatures/garren-bromson.description: Built as a character: deep red and gold armour, shield up, blade raised, cloak swept back behind him. An hourglass sits on the flagstones at his feet.

miniatures/gelatinous-cube.title: Gelatinous Cube
miniatures/gelatinous-cube.description: A translucent cube of digestive jelly, cast clear and tinted from acid yellow at the top down to a murky green at the floor. Whatever it ate is long gone.

miniatures/gibbering-mouthers.title: Gibbering Mouthers
miniatures/gibbering-mouthers.description: Two heaving piles of fused mouths and mismatched eyes in sickly beige. The horror here is that none of the faces agree on where to look.

miniatures/girl-on-beach.title: Girl On Beach
miniatures/girl-on-beach.description: A blonde figure reading on a strip of sand where the surf meets the shore, the base split between wet blue and dry grit. Quietest piece on the shelf.

miniatures/hellhound.title: Hellhound
miniatures/hellhound.description: A hellhound stalking across cracked magma, its coat blended orange into yellow with smoke curling off its paws. The base glows to match.

miniatures/ice-elemental.title: Ice Elemental
miniatures/ice-elemental.description: An elemental cast in translucent blue with a shard of ice erupting beside it, left mostly unpainted so the light travels through the resin.

miniatures/jergal-angels.title: Jergal Angels
miniatures/jergal-angels.description: A matched pair of grey-winged angels in dark robes, each holding a blade and a green flame over a snow base. Identical down to the red sigil freehanded on both robes.

miniatures/laser-car.title: Laser Car
miniatures/laser-car.description: A stripped-down racer with an enormous laser cannon bolted over the cockpit, finished in chipped white. Aerodynamics were not the priority.

miniatures/le-monte-claire.title: Le Monte Claire
miniatures/le-monte-claire.description: A bard mid-flourish in wine-red and gold, holding up a mirror with a face caught in it. He stands on a stone slab set over water with something red submerged beneath it, and he is posed like he knows it.

miniatures/lich-god.title: Lich God
miniatures/lich-god.description: Nagash, crowned in bone and gold with grimoires chained to his robes, rising above a hex-tiled floor. The necrotic energy pouring off him resolves into a swarm of ghosts, hollow-eyed and open-mouthed, each faded toward white at the edges so they read as translucent.

miniatures/little-imp.title: Little Imp
miniatures/little-imp.description: A bright orange imp caught mid-stride on a chunk of rubble, barely larger than a fingernail. Small, red, and clearly up to something.

miniatures/little-lime-octopus.title: Little Lime Octopus
miniatures/little-lime-octopus.description: A tiny octopus in lime green with its arms curled under, painted with a wash that pools in the suckers. No base, no context, just a good octopus.

miniatures/lord-of-bones.title: Lord Of Bones
miniatures/lord-of-bones.description: A skeletal lord on a bat-winged throne built from bones and stacked skulls, robed in red. The throne took more work than its occupant.

miniatures/lord-of-murder.title: Lord Of Murder
miniatures/lord-of-murder.description: A gaunt figure trailing an enormous fan of blades from its back, kept in cold greys on a cracked stone base. The blades read as one silhouette from across the table.

miniatures/lord-of-war.title: Lord Of War
miniatures/lord-of-war.description: An orc warlord with axe and sword raised, planted in a wild tuft of dried grass. The grass is doing a surprising amount of work on the base.

miniatures/machine-gun-buggy.title: Machine Gun Buggy
miniatures/machine-gun-buggy.description: A skeletal dune buggy of open tube framing with a gunner standing at an exposed mount. Almost no bodywork anywhere on it, which feels like a choice.

miniatures/marelle-usinee.title: Marelle Usinee
miniatures/marelle-usinee.description: A character in segmented blue armour with an oversized mechanical arm, conjuring a blue flame in the other hand, standing on planking. Painted cool throughout so the one warm face stands out.

miniatures/master-lich.title: Master Lich
miniatures/master-lich.description: A lich standing beneath a ribbed stone arch, holding an open spellbook glowing green, on a checkered floor. The freehand tiles were the real project.

miniatures/mega-arcanine.title: Mega Arcanine
miniatures/mega-arcanine.description: A repainted Arcanine bulked up into its mega form, orange coat streaked with black tiger striping, shown next to the original figure and a Funko for scale.

miniatures/mimics.title: Mimics
miniatures/mimics.description: A barrel and a chest caught mid-transformation, both peeled open into rings of teeth with tongues lolling out. Never trust furniture.

miniatures/mind-flayers.title: Mind Flayers
miniatures/mind-flayers.description: A matched pair of illithids in violet robes, tentacles curled, each set on a cracked green base. The robes are highlighted up sharply so the folds read at arm's length.

miniatures/missle-junker.title: Missle Junker
miniatures/missle-junker.description: A battered sedan in faded blue with a missile strapped across the roof and mesh over the windows. Rust weathering over most of the panels.

miniatures/mutated-abomination.title: Mutated Abomination
miniatures/mutated-abomination.description: A pale spined horror with a red-ringed central eye over two amber ones, dragging a whipping tail and clutching a scrap of raw flesh. The red is the only warm colour anywhere on it.

miniatures/new-owlbear.title: New Owlbear
miniatures/new-owlbear.description: An owlbear rearing forward in thick brown fur, beak open, on an autumn base with fallen leaves. The fur is drybrushed layer over layer to get that depth.

miniatures/oarfish.title: Oarfish
miniatures/oarfish.description: A long ribbon of oarfish arched over a seabed base, with bright blue and magenta coral tufts below. The fins are fine enough that the light comes through.

miniatures/orange-warrior.title: Orange Warrior
miniatures/orange-warrior.description: A bald warrior in layered orange robes carrying a long blade over one shoulder, on grey flagstones. Confident, unhurried, and entirely orange.

miniatures/orc-carnival-master.title: Orc Carnival Master
miniatures/orc-carnival-master.description: An orc ringmaster in a purple tailcoat and top hat, holding a cane with an orange knob. The carnival is presumably not a safe one.

miniatures/organ-monstrosity.title: Organ Monstrosity
miniatures/organ-monstrosity.description: A raw, flayed thing sprouting arteries in every direction, wielding an axe, standing among skulls. All reds and pinks, with nothing left to the imagination.

miniatures/otyugh-lava.title: Otyugh Lava
miniatures/otyugh-lava.description: An otyugh heaving itself out of a crack in the rock, two eyestalks up and a mouth full of teeth wide open. The base glows orange beneath it.

miniatures/purple-worm.title: Purple Worm
miniatures/purple-worm.description: A purple worm bursting up through broken earth, plates blended violet into bone, its mouth ringed with teeth around a glossy red throat. Strands of saliva still stretch across the opening, which is the detail that makes it.

miniatures/rainbow-beetles.title: Rainbow Beetles
miniatures/rainbow-beetles.description: Two beetles on cracked earth bases, one shelled in iridescent blue-violet and the other in warm brown. The shimmer on the first is layered glaze rather than a single colour.

miniatures/ritual-circle.title: Ritual Circle
miniatures/ritual-circle.description: A ring of standing stones set with skulls and candles, built as a free-standing scatter piece. Drop it on the table and everyone immediately knows what is about to happen.

miniatures/ritual-cultist.title: Ritual Cultist
miniatures/ritual-cultist.description: A hooded cultist raising a curved dagger, painted almost entirely in black with the highlights doing all the shape work. The book at the waist is the only spot of color.

miniatures/rot-fountain.title: Rot Fountain
miniatures/rot-fountain.description: A carved stone fountain pouring something dark red into a basin of stagnant yellow-green sludge, both rendered thick and glossy. Nobody is drinking from this one.

miniatures/rust-monster.title: Rust Monster
miniatures/rust-monster.description: A rust monster in copper and orange, antennae forward and feathered tail up, scuttling off a rocky base. It is coming for your armor specifically.

miniatures/rusted-frames.title: Rusted Frames
miniatures/rusted-frames.description: Three car shells stripped to bare bodywork and weathered to near-total rust, one still carrying a painted target on the door. Wrecks waiting to be built into something.

miniatures/sahuaghin-trident.title: Sahuaghin Trident
miniatures/sahuaghin-trident.description: A sahuagin lunging with trident in hand, painted in mottled green over a lighter belly. The skin is stippled rather than blended, so it reads as scaly from a distance.

miniatures/skeleton-archers.title: Skeleton Archers
miniatures/skeleton-archers.description: Two skeletons drawing longbows on bright green bases, ribs and joints picked out in bone and shadow. Cheap troops, endlessly reusable.

miniatures/slagfist.title: Slagfist
miniatures/slagfist.description: An armored fighter flanked by two dome-shelled drones on articulated legs. The freehand gold filigree on the central base is the detail worth looking for.

miniatures/sludge-monster.title: Sludge Monster
miniatures/sludge-monster.description: A pale bloated giant dragging chains, hide stretched over a gaping torso cavity, standing on toxic green. The chains are real chain, which is why they hang right.

miniatures/small-beetle.title: Small Beetle
miniatures/small-beetle.description: One dark beetle on a mossy green base, glossy and unbothered. Small enough that the base is most of what you see.

miniatures/snowy-owlbear.title: Snowy Owlbear
miniatures/snowy-owlbear.description: An owlbear in white and grey winter plumage, hunched low with one claw raised. The red eye is the only warm color anywhere on it.

miniatures/soul-grinder.title: Soul Grinder
miniatures/soul-grinder.description: A daemon torso in blue fading to magenta, bolted at the waist into a brass walker that stalks on four bladed legs. The arms end in toothed pincers instead of hands, and every foot is its own cluster of blades - this one needs its own footprint on the table.

miniatures/speedy-car.title: Speedy Car
miniatures/speedy-car.description: A low red muscle car with a blown hood and blue windows, weathered down along the edges. Fast, and not much else.

miniatures/swamp-monster.title: Swamp Monster
miniatures/swamp-monster.description: A bloated swamp creature in teal and sickly green, arms out, standing among moss clumps. The palette is all cold, which makes it read as damp.

miniatures/t-rex.title: T-Rex
miniatures/t-rex.description: A T-Rex mid-stride through jungle undergrowth, green darkening to near-black along the spine and fading to pale underneath. Blood is still on the jaws, arms and legs, with saliva stretched between the teeth - this one has just eaten.

miniatures/tentacle-pair.title: Tentacle Pair
miniatures/tentacle-pair.description: Two tentacles bursting up through sculpted whitewater, one dark purple and one violet, each on its own base. Sold separately, encountered together.

miniatures/thought-devourer.title: Thought Devourer
miniatures/thought-devourer.description: An exposed pink brain riding a set of splayed yellow legs. It is exactly as unsettling as that sounds, and it fits on a thumbnail.

miniatures/tiefling-sorceror-green-dress.title: Tiefling Sorceror Green Dress
miniatures/tiefling-sorceror-green-dress.description: A tiefling sorcerer in a green dress with red skin and trailing hair, dagger drawn, standing on stone. The hair and the horns carry the whole silhouette.

miniatures/tormin-mahaloom.title: Tormin Mahaloom
miniatures/tormin-mahaloom.description: A loxodon fighter in gold armour, curved sword held low and shield up, a quiver slung across his back. He stands on cracked earth with a skull by his feet.

miniatures/triple-grell.title: Triple Grell
miniatures/triple-grell.description: Three grells, each a floating brain trailing a curtain of tan tentacles around a hooked beak. Painted as a set so they read as one encounter.

miniatures/twilight-imperium-prints.title: Twilight Imperium Prints
miniatures/twilight-imperium-prints.description: A full set of Twilight Imperium fleets printed and painted by faction, laid out across the kitchen table and sorted by color. Every ship in the box, replaced.

miniatures/twin-statues.title: Twin Statues
miniatures/twin-statues.description: Two stone guardian statues, one holding a basin and one a sword, painted entirely in greys to read as carved rock rather than a figure.

miniatures/water-elemental.title: Water Elemental
miniatures/water-elemental.description: An elemental of curling translucent water, left largely unpainted so the light passes straight through the resin. Only the shadows are painted in.

miniatures/water-ninja.title: Water Ninja
miniatures/water-ninja.description: Standing ankle-deep in poured water with the ripples still spreading from where she put her feet down, an oversized shuriken held low at her side. The burgundy hood and sash are the only warm colours against all that cold teal.

miniatures/water-slaad.title: Water Slaad
miniatures/water-slaad.description: A slaad in cold blue with magenta running down its throat, belly and the inside of every limb, tongue lolling out over a mouth full of teeth. It's holding a bone in one hand, and the hot pink against all that blue is the entire trick.

miniatures/weaponized-jeep.title: Weaponized Jeep
miniatures/weaponized-jeep.description: A red jeep armored in bolted plate and mounted skulls, with a spotlight rig on the roof. Every panel is chipped down to bare metal.

miniatures/white-spectator.title: White Spectator
miniatures/white-spectator.description: A small pale spectator with four eyestalks and a wide grin, hovering over an earth base. Friendlier than a beholder, if only slightly.

miniatures/wraith-couple.title: Wraith Couple
miniatures/wraith-couple.description: Two wraiths in trailing robes, one violet and one pale blue, both fading out toward the hem so they read as half-solid.

miniatures/zombicorn.title: Zombicorn
miniatures/zombicorn.description: A unicorn well past its prime, mane and tail rotted to green, gold horn still intact. The horn was kept clean so it is obvious what it used to be.

terrain/coals.title: Coals
terrain/coals.description: A bed of banked coals sculpted across a round base, each lump glazed orange in the cracks and left charred on top. Built to drop under something that is about to be on fire.

terrain/destroyed-castle.title: Destroyed Castle
terrain/destroyed-castle.description: A ruined keep with one wall collapsed into rubble, carved block by block and weathered grey with moss creeping through the debris.

terrain/destroyed-column.title: Destroyed Column
terrain/destroyed-column.description: A toppled classical column half-buried on a round base, grass growing over the drum sections. Small piece, does a lot of scene-setting.

terrain/docks.title: Docks
terrain/docks.description: Modular boardwalk sections on pilings, planked individually and weathered to look waterlogged. They connect in different arrangements so the harbor changes shape.

terrain/egg-pit.title: Egg Pit
terrain/egg-pit.description: A nest of glassy orange eggs packed into a dark rock hollow, built up in clusters so the light catches unevenly across the mass.

terrain/firestacks.title: Firestacks
terrain/firestacks.description: Four fire markers lit from inside, with smoke columns teased out of wool above each flame. The glow is real, which is why they photograph so well in the dark.

terrain/floating-crystal.title: Floating Crystal
terrain/floating-crystal.description: A huge pink crystal suspended above a mossy outcrop by chains, angled so it looks tethered rather than resting. The faceting is cut, not sculpted.

terrain/golden-portal.title: Golden Portal
terrain/golden-portal.description: A gold-framed gateway flanked by winged lions, the interior a swirl of violet. Set on flagstones so it reads as built rather than conjured.

terrain/golden-scales.title: Golden Scales
terrain/golden-scales.description: A working set of balance scales built from wire and thin discs, with pans that actually hang level. Small enough to sit on a single base.

terrain/ice-disc-base.title: Ice Disc Base
terrain/ice-disc-base.description: A frozen pool with a crack star bursting from the center, poured in translucent blue over a textured disc. Something recently went through it.

terrain/ice-pillars-base.title: Ice Pillars Base
terrain/ice-pillars-base.description: A cluster of grey ice shards pushing up through snow, kept almost colorless so it reads as cold rather than blue.

terrain/infinity-portal.title: Infinity Portal
terrain/infinity-portal.description: An infinity mirror portal rigged with LEDs, so the ring of lights recedes into what looks like a bottomless shaft. Best appreciated with the lights off.

terrain/insect-eggs.title: Insect Eggs
terrain/insect-eggs.description: A sheet of webbing stretched over yellow egg clusters and dark growth, built up in translucent layers so the eggs sit under the web rather than on it.

terrain/lavaplatform.title: Lavaplatform
terrain/lavaplatform.description: A rock platform balanced on a column of pouring lava, blended white-hot at the core to deep orange at the edges. The lava is the support, structurally and visually.

terrain/magic-rune-tile.title: Magic Rune Tile
terrain/magic-rune-tile.description: A dungeon floor tile with a rune cut clean through and lit green from beneath. Innocuous with the lights up, considerably less so in the dark.

terrain/mutated-trees.title: Mutated Trees
terrain/mutated-trees.description: Three dead trees split open to reveal toothed mouths running up their trunks, rooted among bones and moss. The bark texture hides the mouth until you are close.

terrain/oblex-well.title: Oblex Well
terrain/oblex-well.description: A stone well glowing orange from somewhere deep below the rim. Whatever is down there is lit, awake, and not water.

terrain/ocean-rock.title: Ocean Rock
terrain/ocean-rock.description: A flat grey rock rising out of deep blue water, with sculpted foam breaking white around its base. Built as a display plinth as much as terrain.

terrain/oiltank.title: Oiltank
terrain/oiltank.description: A fuel drum on a welded cradle, rusted through in patches down to bare metal. Built as industrial scatter, and weathered until it looks abandoned rather than merely old.

terrain/prisma-wall.title: Prisma Wall
terrain/prisma-wall.description: A wall of crystal shards in a full spectrum, running green through blue to violet along its length. Every shard is placed individually, which is why the gradient is smooth.

terrain/puke-fountain.title: Puke Fountain
terrain/puke-fountain.description: An ornate fountain producing something that is emphatically not water. The sculpture is elegant; the output is not.

terrain/river.title: River
terrain/river.description: A full gaming board with a river cut through it, banks built up in layers of flock and gravel, poplars along the far side. The water is poured resin with the bed painted before it went in.

terrain/ruined-windmill.title: Ruined Windmill
terrain/ruined-windmill.description: A windmill with its sails half rotted away and its tower opened to the weather, built from stripped timber on a stone base. It looks structurally unsound, which is the point.

terrain/shed-on-the-hill.title: Shed On The Hill
terrain/shed-on-the-hill.description: A tile-roofed shed sitting on a grassy rise with rock faces carved down the sides. The whole hill is the model, not just the building.

terrain/sludge-crater.title: Sludge Crater
terrain/sludge-crater.description: A crater of green sludge draining out through a breach in the rim, poured glossy so it still looks wet. Something toxic happened here.

terrain/snowy-crater.title: Snowy Crater
terrain/snowy-crater.description: A frozen impact crater with a deep blue pool at the center and snow thrown up over the rim in rays. Cold enough to read from across the table.

terrain/temple-interior.title: Temple Interior
terrain/temple-interior.description: A full temple built to scale, with cobbled stone floors, banner-lined walls, and a rose window rising behind the altar. Angel statues flank the dais, and the pews are ready for a congregation.

terrain/tilled-farmland.title: Tilled Farmland
terrain/tilled-farmland.description: A field of ploughed furrows with crops coming up in rows, every ridge scored by hand. Unglamorous, and exactly what a village board needs.

terrain/trashed-terrain.title: Trashed Terrain
terrain/trashed-terrain.description: A fenced enclosure of churned ground and dead grass, built from scrap sticks and offcuts. Proof that a good board section does not need good materials.

terrain/two-level-simple-house.title: Two Level Simple House
terrain/two-level-simple-house.description: A timber-framed house with whitewashed panels over a rough stone ground floor, built to be lifted apart by level so figures can go inside.

terrain/underdark-rock-pillars.title: Underdark Rock Pillars
terrain/underdark-rock-pillars.description: Stacked purple rock formations studded with glowing fungus in pink and blue. Nothing down here is lit by the sun, so everything had to glow on its own.

terrain/water-fall.title: Water Fall
terrain/water-fall.description: A waterfall pouring into a rock pool, the falling water sculpted clear and whipped white where it lands. Moss and scree built up the banks around it.

terrain/waystone.title: Waystone
terrain/waystone.description: A carved standing stone on a low rise, with a dirt track running past and trees at either end. A landmark piece, built to mark where the party is rather than fight over.

modelkits/chibi-dragon-gundam.title: Chibi Dragon Gundam
modelkits/chibi-dragon-gundam.description: A chibi-proportioned Dragon Gundam in orange and violet, flame effects mounted on both fists. All squashed-down proportions and no restraint.

modelkits/garchomp.title: Garchomp
modelkits/garchomp.description: A Garchomp model kit snapped together in navy and red, fins out and posed low. Built clean out of the box, no paint needed.

modelkits/gold-unicorn.title: Gold Unicorn
modelkits/gold-unicorn.description: The Unicorn Gundam in full gold plating with psychoframe panels exposed, beam rifle and sabre mounted. Every panel line had to stay crisp against that much reflective surface.

modelkits/gundam-centaur.title: Gundam Centaur
modelkits/gundam-centaur.description: A centaur-framed Gundam in black and red, bow drawn, standing on four legs instead of two. The rear legs carry the whole pose, so the joints had to be tight.

modelkits/gundam-chibi.title: Gundam Chibi
modelkits/gundam-chibi.description: An SD Gundam in full ceremonial gold and blue with flame-shaped effect parts fanned out behind it. Tiny body, enormous backdrop.

modelkits/gundam-submarine.title: Gundam Submarine
modelkits/gundam-submarine.description: A pale blue aquatic mobile suit standing on four clawed legs. Built straight from the kit, with the leg articulation doing all the character work.

modelkits/gundam-transforming.title: Gundam Transforming
modelkits/gundam-transforming.description: A white transforming Gundam with beam sabre drawn and wings deployed. It converts between modes, which means every joint has to hold in two different configurations.

modelkits/lego-bonsai.title: Lego Bonsai
modelkits/lego-bonsai.description: The LEGO bonsai built with its pink cherry blossom canopy and displayed on a slatted wooden stand. Every blossom is a tiny frog piece in disguise.

modelkits/lego-flowers.title: Lego Flowers
modelkits/lego-flowers.description: A deep red LEGO flower opened out in a black planter, photographed from directly above so the petal geometry reads. Ten builds in the set, no water required.

modelkits/lego-insects.title: Lego Insects
modelkits/lego-insects.description: The LEGO insect collection posed together on a clear stand with mushrooms and foliage, built as one display rather than three separate models.

modelkits/little-arm-gundam.title: Little Arm Gundam
modelkits/little-arm-gundam.description: A compact olive-green mobile suit built out of the box, squat and heavily armored. Not every kit needs to be a centerpiece.

modelkits/metagross.title: Metagross
modelkits/metagross.description: Metagross snapped together in teal and steel, all four legs planted and the X across its face lined up clean. Built without glue or paint.

modelkits/paladinmon.title: Paladinmon
modelkits/paladinmon.description: A Digimon knight in red and gold with a lance and shield, cape hanging behind. The plated armor and the cloth cape are separate materials in the kit, and both had to sit right.

modelkits/rayquaza.title: Rayquaza
modelkits/rayquaza.description: Rayquaza built in segments so the whole body coils, mounted on a cloud stand. The segmented spine is what lets it hold a pose at all.

modelkits/steampunk-beetles.title: Steampunk Beetles
modelkits/steampunk-beetles.description: Two clockwork insects in brass and red, wings spread on turned display bases with brass plaques. Mechanical kits built to be furniture, not toys.

other/axolotl.title: Axolotl
other/axolotl.description: A print-in-place articulated axolotl in pink, with gills and limbs that flex straight off the print bed. No assembly, no glue, just support removal.

other/bulbasaur.title: Bulbasaur
other/bulbasaur.description: A Bulbasaur planter printed in teal with a real succulent growing out of the bulb. The vines were printed separately and run out across the counter.

other/candle-bowl.title: Candle Bowl
other/candle-bowl.description: A d12 candle sitting in a printed bowl holder, numbers picked out in white against blue. A natural twenty was structurally unavailable.

other/clancy-dinner-ornament.title: Clancy Dinner Ornament
other/clancy-dinner-ornament.description: A family gathered around the dinner table, printed and hand painted figure by figure on a wood-grain base. Made as an ornament, which is why everyone is recognizable.

other/currency.title: Currency
other/currency.description: A set of fantasy coins and tokens, each with its own sculpted face and finished in a different metal. Printed as a batch so the whole set matches in scale.

other/daycare-railing-fix.title: Daycare Railing Fix
other/daycare-railing-fix.description: A printed bracket that caps a railing post and anchors it back to the wall. Not decorative in the slightest, and it solved the problem.

other/dino-skull.title: Dino Skull
other/dino-skull.description: A large T-Rex skull printed and finished with a bone wash, teeth left bright against the aged surface. Printed hollow, because otherwise it would be unliftable.

other/door-fix.title: Door Fix
other/door-fix.description: A printed replacement for a broken door stop, fitted straight into the existing hole in the floor. Ten minutes of modeling instead of a trip to the hardware store.

other/doug-firefighter-lightbar.title: Doug Firefighter Lightbar
other/doug-firefighter-lightbar.description: A lightbar printed in translucent orange and lit from inside, so the layer lines diffuse the glow rather than spoiling it. Printed for a firefighter, and it shows.

other/earrings.title: Earrings
other/earrings.description: A full Halloween run of earrings cut and assembled in batches, from ghosts and pumpkins to coffins, spiders and Frankensteins. Made to be given away by the handful.

other/fence-coat-hangar.title: Fence Coat Hangar
other/fence-coat-hangar.description: A coat rack built as a run of miniature picket fence, each picket angled to work as a hook. Practical, and nobody guesses what it is until it is pointed out.

other/first-date-map-print.title: First Date Map Print
other/first-date-map-print.description: A framed street map with a heart marking one intersection, rendered flat in blocked color. A specific place, kept for a specific reason.

other/flower-petal-bookmarks.title: Flower Petal Bookmarks
other/flower-petal-bookmarks.description: Pressed petals sealed into bookmark strips, arranged so the autumn tones run in sequence along each one. The flowers are real and preserved flat.

other/hades-charon-coin.title: Hades Charon Coin
other/hades-charon-coin.description: Charon's obol from Hades, printed in two colors so the red glyph sits proud of the gold face. Printed as a prop rather than a model.

other/inspiration-coin.title: Inspiration Coin
other/inspiration-coin.description: A printed table caddy holding an inspiration token and a d20, stacked so both sit within reach of whoever needs them next.

other/isolation.title: Isolation
other/isolation.description: A split diorama with a snowbound peak on one side and a green cliff on the other, one lone figure at the top. Built during a period that the title explains.

other/manatee.title: Manatee
other/manatee.description: A manatee printed smooth and finished in soft grey, rolled onto its back mid-float. No base, no scene, just a very content sea cow.

other/mareep.title: Mareep
other/mareep.description: A Mareep with a fleece textured rough against smooth blue limbs, tail orb painted to look lit. The contrast in surface finish is what sells the wool.

other/mario-kart-trophies.title: Mario Kart Trophies
other/mario-kart-trophies.description: A set of Mario Kart trophies printed for a birthday tournament, complete with a plinth reading Happy Birthday. Awarded, presumably, with appropriate ceremony.

other/mothers-day-diorama.title: Mothers Day Diorama
other/mothers-day-diorama.description: A garden island with two blossoming trees, a stream, a statue and flowers scattered through the grass, set on carved rock. Built as a gift, and it has served as a site banner since.

other/ocean-turtle.title: Ocean Turtle
other/ocean-turtle.description: A sea turtle with its shell painted in warm reds and golds against brown flippers, photographed from above so the plate pattern reads clearly.

other/oil-rain-lamp.title: Oil Rain Lamp
other/oil-rain-lamp.description: A restored oil rain lamp, with the oil running down fine lines around a central figure. The hardest part of these is getting them flowing evenly again.

other/paint-setup.title: Paint Setup
other/paint-setup.description: The paint rack, fully stocked and sorted by color family, with wet palettes and brushes within reach. Every other project on this site came off this bench.

other/planters.title: Planters
other/planters.description: Ribbed planters printed in deep red and filled with succulents. The vertical fluting hides the layer lines completely, which is the whole reason for the shape.

other/pokedex.title: Pokedex
other/pokedex.description: A Pokedex printed in red with the shell detail modeled in, closed and roughly palm sized. Printed as a prop, not a working device.

other/pressed-flowers.title: Pressed Flowers
other/pressed-flowers.description: Real flowers pressed and set into resin panels over colored backings, each arrangement built around a single stem. The blue backings let the dried stems read as silhouettes.

other/printed-fancy-wallet.title: Printed Fancy Wallet
other/printed-fancy-wallet.description: A printed wallet with a hinged cover, holding cards and folded bills in a body thin enough to pocket. The hinge is printed as part of the shell rather than assembled.

other/real-potions.title: Real Potions
other/real-potions.description: Cork-stoppered bottles filled with colored liquid in red, green and blue, in three different vessel shapes. Real glass, real liquid, effects unverified.

other/refurbished-shelf.title: Refurbished Shelf
other/refurbished-shelf.description: A rebuilt display shelf holding the plant and insect builds together, each on its own level with the terrariums at the bottom. The shelf was the project; the contents moved in afterward.

other/rocket-league-diorama.title: Rocket League Diorama
other/rocket-league-diorama.description: A Rocket League goal moment frozen in place, with the car airborne and a wool smoke trail behind it. The smoke is teased out by hand so it holds the arc.

other/scarearium.title: Scarearium
other/scarearium.description: A graveyard terrarium in a glass cube, with a bare wire tree, headstones, a tomb and scattered bone over dark soil. A terrarium that cannot die, which is thematically correct.

other/spice-rack.title: Spice Rack
other/spice-rack.description: Rotating bottle holders that pull five jars out of the dead space at the back of the cabinet, turning a shelf you had to dig through into one you can read at a glance.

other/uss-congress.title: USS Congress
other/uss-congress.description: A wooden ship model with three masts stepped and the hull planked and gunported, shown before the rigging goes on. Built plank by plank from a kit.

other/witchlight-carnival-tickets.title: Witchlight Carnival Tickets
other/witchlight-carnival-tickets.description: Holographic carnival tickets printed and cut as table handouts, each one listing its own attraction. Props that get passed to players rather than looked at on a shelf.

other/wizard-wars.title: Wizard Wars
other/wizard-wars.description: An original wizard duelling game, complete with a spellbook board, illustrated casters and a start token. Designed, drawn and built from scratch.
